doc.summary: LLM backend factory and selection utilities.
doc.description:
This module centralizes language model instantiation so that every caller
in the framework reads its provider, model name, host, and credentials
from a single source: ``payload.json``. The factory removes hardcoded
model strings duplicated across six callers and enforces the
Dependency Inversion Principle by returning the abstract :class:`AIModel`
type while keeping the concrete backend choice under operator control.

Adding a new backend means implementing :class:`AIModel` and registering
its identifier in :data:`SUPPORTED_BACKENDS`. No other module needs to
change.

The factory wraps every returned backend with the
:class:`core.llm_budget.BudgetedBackend` proxy so the daily cost cap
and the per call token cap are enforced at the single chokepoint the
framework uses. Callers that want the raw backend for testing can
call :func:`get_llm_backend_raw` instead.

name: SUPPORTED_BACKENDS
value: (BACKEND_GROQ, BACKEND_OLLAMA, BACKEND_OPENAI, BACKEND_ANTHROPIC, BACKEND_DEEPSEEK, BACKEND_LLAMACPP, BACKEND_AUTO)

doc.summary: Return True when an error text means the model id is unavailable.

params.name: message
params.description: Exception instance, error string, or API payload text.

returns.description:
``True`` for 404/model_not_found style replies from OpenAI-compatible
APIs, so callers can fail over to another model id.

name: groq_model_chain
signature: def groq_model_chain(config: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> tuple[str, ...]

doc.summary: Return the ordered Groq model ids to try, configured model first.
doc.description:
Resolution order per slot: ``LAZYOWN_GROQ_MODEL`` env var, the provided
config mapping, ``payload.json`` key ``llm_model_groq``, then the default.
Known-good fallbacks follow so an account without access to the default
model still gets a working backend.

returns.description: Tuple of unique, non-empty model ids in try order.

doc.summary: Raised when no LLM backend can be instantiated from the current config.
Raised when the requested backend identifier is unknown.
Return the default model identifier for a backend.
doc.description:
``"auto"`` resolves to the Groq default because the auto chain tries
the Groq cloud leg first.

raises.name: LLMBackendNotSupportedError
raises.description: When the identifier is not supported.

doc.summary: Return the ``payload.json`` key holding a backend's model override.
doc.description:
``"auto"`` maps to the Groq model slot because the auto chain tries
the Groq cloud leg first.

returns.description: Config key for the model override.

raises.name: LLMBackendNotSupportedError
raises.description: When the identifier is not supported.

name: api_key_config_key
signature: def api_key_config_key(backend: str | None) -> str | None

doc.summary: Return the ``payload.json`` key holding a backend's API key slot.
doc.description:
Returns ``None`` for Ollama (keyless local daemon). ``"auto"`` maps
to the Groq key slot because the auto chain tries Groq first.

returns.description: Config key for the API key, or None when no key is needed.

raises.name: LLMBackendNotSupportedError
raises.description: When the identifier is not supported.

doc.summary: Report whether a backend needs an API key to operate.
doc.description:
Only Ollama runs keyless. ``"auto"`` reports True because its cloud
leg needs a key (it still degrades to keyless Ollama without one).

returns.description: True when an API key is required, False for Ollama.

raises.name: LLMBackendNotSupportedError
raises.description: When the identifier is not supported.

name: load_payload
signature: def load_payload(payload_path: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]

doc.summary: Read ``payload.json`` from disk and return it as a dictionary.

params.name: payload_path
params.description: Optional explicit path. Defaults to the repository's ``payload.json`` resolved relative to this module's parent.

returns.description:
The parsed payload mapping, or an empty dictionary if the file
is missing or unreadable. Errors are swallowed so the factory
can fall back to environment variables and defaults.

name: get_llm_backend
signature: def get_llm_backend(config: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, backend: str | None = None) -> AIModel

doc.summary: Return a concrete :class:`AIModel` selected by configuration.
doc.description:
The selection order is:

1. Explicit ``backend`` argument when provided.
2. ``llm_backend`` key from ``config`` (or loaded ``payload.json``).
3. :data:`DEFAULT_BACKEND` (``"auto"``).

When the resolved backend is ``"auto"`` the factory tries Groq first
(if an API key is available) and falls back to Ollama. Any other
explicit selection is honoured strictly: callers receive
:class:`LLMBackendUnavailableError` rather than a silent fallback so
they can decide whether to degrade or raise.

The returned backend is wrapped with the budget proxy so the daily
cost cap and the per call token cap are enforced at the single
chokepoint the framework uses. Use :func:`get_llm_backend_raw` to
bypass the wrapper for tests that need a raw backend.

params.name: config
params.description: Optional pre-loaded payload mapping. When ``None`` the payload is read from disk.

params.name: backend
params.description: Optional override for the backend identifier. Takes precedence over the configuration value.

returns.description:
A configured :class:`AIModel` instance that also structurally
satisfies :class:`core.protocols.LLMBackend`, ready for either
``generate`` or ``complete`` calls.

raises.name: LLMBackendNotSupportedError
raises.description: When an unsupported identifier is requested.

raises.name: LLMBackendUnavailableError
raises.description:
When the requested backend cannot
be constructed from the current environment (for example,
Groq selected with no API key).

name: get_llm_backend_raw
signature: def get_llm_backend_raw(config: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, backend: str | None = None) -> AIModel

doc.summary: Return a raw :class:`AIModel` without the budget wrapper.
doc.description:
Tests and the CLI command ``llm_budget`` itself use this entry
point so the budget proxy never recurses into itself. Production
callers should keep using :func:`get_llm_backend`.

name: try_get_llm_backend
signature: def try_get_llm_backend(config: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, backend: str | None = None) -> AIModel | None

doc.summary: Return a backend or ``None`` if construction fails for any reason.
doc.description:
Wraps :func:`get_llm_backend` so call sites that prefer to degrade
gracefully (CLI assistants, opportunistic enrichers) can keep
working when no LLM is reachable.

returns.description:
A configured :class:`AIModel`, or ``None`` when no backend is
available.

name: stream_complete
signature: def stream_complete(model: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 800, on_delta: Callable[[str], None] | None = None) -> str

doc.summary: Completion that reports incremental deltas while it arrives.
doc.description:
Streams through the configured backend's ``stream_generate`` when the
provider supports it and silently falls back to :func:`complete` on
any error, so a backend without streaming never breaks a caller.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Prompt text (truncated to 6000 chars like the pool path).

params.name: max_tokens
params.description: Upper bound hint for the provider.

params.name: on_delta
params.description: Optional callback invoked with each text fragment.

name: complete
signature: def complete(model: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 800) -> str

doc.summary: Complete a prompt through one model spec; raise when unanswered.
doc.description:
The ``model`` spec accepts an optional ``backend:`` prefix selecting
the leg: ``groq:``, ``ollama:``, ``llamacpp:``, ``pi:`` (local pi agent,
keyless), ``auto:`` (groq first, then ollama)
or ``toposwarm:`` (local agentic router, keyless). A bare model name
resolves through the ``auto`` chain. Empty prompt returns empty
string; any backend outage raises so pool callers can fail over to
the next leg and finally to the heuristic path.

params.name: model
params.description: Model spec, optionally prefixed with backend.

returns.description: Response text, never empty on success.
